newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Mergers and acquisitions soar in Brazil in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Mergers and acquisitions soar in Brazil in 1996.

text.p: Mergers and acquisitions soared in Brazil in 1996 to 369, 14 percent more than in 1995 and 48 percent higher than in 1994, according to a survey by consulting firm Price Waterhouse.
Forty-nine percent of the deals were takeovers, which were up 36 percent over 1995, the firm said.
Foreign investors acquired 49 percent of the companies that changed hands in 1996 and participated in 78 percent of the new joint ventures, it also said.
Most of the deals took place in the chemical, petrochemical, food, computer, auto parts and food sectors.
